SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7495
Date 11 - 9 - 36

September 11 36.

Dear Mr. Barton,

With reference to your letter dated
August 11, 1936, I have to inform you that
Miss Cecile Marie-Therise Martineau arrived in
Shanghai from Hongkong by the s.s. "Soochow" on
August 1, 1936, travelling on French passport
No. 37550, issued at Paris on July 13, 1933 and
visaed at Saigon on June 26, 1936. When filling
the Alien's Passport Declaration Form, she gave
her address as c/o the Portuguese Consulate, Shanghai.

Information has now been received that
Miss Martineau left Shanghai for Japan three weeks
after her arrival and is reported to be now residing
at a Catholic Convent in Tokyo. It is not expected
that she will return to Shanghai before January of
next year.

Yours sincerely,

HR

James Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别支部登记处
编号 S. B. D. 7495
日期 1936 年 9 月 11 日

1936 年 9 月 11 日。

亲爱的巴顿先生：

关于你方 1936 年 8 月 11 日的来信，兹通知你，塞西尔·玛丽-泰丽丝·马蒂诺小姐（Miss Cecile Marie-Therise Martineau）于 1936 年 8 月 1 日乘坐“苏州”号轮船（s.s. "Soochow"）从香港抵达上海，持法国护照第 37550 号，该护照于 1933 年 7 月 13 日在巴黎签发，并于 1936 年 6 月 26 日在西贡签证。她在填写外侨护照申报表时，提供的地址为上海葡萄牙领事馆转交。

现收到消息，马蒂诺小姐在抵达三周后离开上海前往日本，据报目前居住在东京的一所天主教修道院。预计她在明年一月之前不会返回上海。

此致
敬礼，

HR

詹姆斯·巴顿先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

REPORT
File No. 7495
1st copy - 26
Date September 10, 36.

Subject (in full) Movements of Miss Cecile Marie-Therise Martineau.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J. Coyne D.S.I.

Miss Cecile Marie-Therise Martineau, subject of an enquiry
from H.B.M. Consulate-General, arrived at Shanghai from Hongkong
by the s.s. "Soochow" on August 1, 1936, travelling on French
passport No.37550, issued at Paris on July 13, 1933 and visaed
at Saigon on June 26, 1936.
On the Alien's passport Declaration Form which she filled
in on arrival here she gave her address as c/o the Portuguese
Consulate, Shanghai.
Information has now been obtained that she left Shanghai
for Japan about three weeks ago. No mention of her name, however,
can be found on the shipping lists of departures.
She is now believed to be residing at a Catholic convent
in Tokyo and is not expected to return to Shanghai before
January of next year.

D. S. Jones
Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
档案编号 7495
第一份副本 - 26
日期 1936 年 9 月 10 日。

主题（全称）塞西尔·玛丽-泰丽丝·马蒂诺小姐的行踪。

制作人：警佐琼斯（D.S. Jones） 转发人：特别支部督察长科因（J. Coyne D.S.I.）

塞西尔·玛丽-泰丽丝·马蒂诺小姐，系英国总领事馆查询之对象，于 1936 年 8 月 1 日乘坐“苏州”号轮船从香港抵达上海，持法国护照第 37550 号，该护照于 1933 年 7 月 13 日在巴黎签发，并于 1936 年 6 月 26 日在西贡签证。
她在抵达时填写的外侨护照申报表上，提供的地址为上海葡萄牙领事馆转交。
现已获得消息，她约在三周前离开上海前往日本。然而，在离境船运名单中未找到其姓名的记录。
据信她目前居住在东京的一所天主教修道院，预计明年一月之前不会返回上海。

D. S. 琼斯
特别支部主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. D. REGIST
No. S. D. 2495
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
Date ____ 11 / 8 36
P.O. BOX 100. SHANGHAI.

11th August, 1936.

My dear Robertson,
have
The Hong Kong Police informed me that a
certain Miss Cecile Marie-Therese MARTINEAU, French citizen,
holding passport No.37550 issued at Paris on July 13th,
1933, left Hong Kong for Shanghai in the S.S. "Soochow" on
July 28th. I now learn that this woman is on the suspect
list of the Government of India in view of unsatisfactory
references given by her when she applied for an Indian
visa.

Although I do not think there is any necessity
for her local activities to be watched, I should be very much
obliged to you if you could possibly inform me if and when
she leaves Shanghai and for what destination.

Yours sincerely,
〔签名〕

T. Robertson, Esquire,
SHANGHAI.

S.2.
D.R.
11/8.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)）

上海公共租界
S. D. 登记处
编号 S. D. 2495
英国总领事馆，
日期 1936 年 8 月 11 日
邮政信箱 100 号。上海。

1936 年 8 月 11 日。

亲爱的罗伯逊：

香港警方通知我，某位塞西尔·玛丽-泰蕾丝·马蒂诺小姐（Miss Cecile Marie-Therese MARTINEAU），法国公民，持有 1933 年 7 月 13 日在巴黎签发的第 37550 号护照，于 7 月 28 日乘坐“苏州”号轮船离开香港前往上海。我现获悉，鉴于该女子在申请印度签证时提供的推荐信令人不满，她已被列入印度政府的嫌疑名单。

虽然我认为没有必要对其在当地的活动进行监视，但如你能告知我她是否及何时离开上海以及前往何地，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
〔签名〕

T. 罗伯逊先生，
上海。

S.2.
D.R.
8 月 11 日。

（印：副总监（刑事部））
